findings.problem: The new test depends on CASE18 having no current route, and the legacy seed gives it one. In backend/database/seed/20-fixtures-rait.sql:134, assignment 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000022000008 is active for case 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000010000018 in pool 00000000-0000-7000-8000-000020000002. The suite needs the legacy-upgrade profile, because CASE17, CASE18 and CASE19 exist only in seed 20 and 40, not in the fresh profile. RaitCaseCommandFixture.resetMutableState (backend/app/tests/shared/rait-case-command.fixture.ts:147-157) sets every seeded 0000220000% assignment except 22000006 back to active=true. Neither prepareScope nor clearScopes, nor any earlier test in this spec, releases 22000008. The only other mutation, in rait-ctg2-final-structural.e2e.spec.ts:64, runs inside a rollback. On the documented DB state, `expect(routing).toEqual({link:false, assignment:false, accepted_batch:false})` at lines 1100-1110 is therefore expected to fail with assignment:true. Even if that assertion were removed, the 404 control would not hold. poolCaseSql (rait-case-scope.service.ts:854) accepts `qa.pool_id=qp.id and qa.active` as an exact route, so the create-batch check at rait-worklist-command.service.ts:556-567 would let CASE18 through. The test design is sound, but on the seed it states it uses, it cannot show the closure. The same false claim that CASE18 is 'unlinked' appears in the resolutions record. The final 355-HTTP rerun, which would include this test, is still pending, so no executed result contradicts this.
findings.recommendation: Inspector-only, test-local fix, with no DDL, runtime or permission change. Before the negative, capture the full seeded row 22000008 and set it to active=false, released_at=now(), release_reason='afastamento'. The spec already uses this pattern at line 2090. Then assert that no active link, assignment or accepted batch exists, and run the identical 404 request with its no-effects and unchanged-row assertions. Add only the trusted fixture case_pool_scope link and assert 201 with the exact item. In finally, delete the owned batch/items and fixture link, then restore 22000008 exactly from the captured row. Alternatively, reactivating 22000008 can serve as the trusted exact route for the positive. Either way, the negative must run with no current route of any kind to pool 20000002. Correct the CASE18 'unlinked' wording in the resolutions record.
